headings.usage: Use tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for massive text. Heavy use of uppercase.

body.usage: Used for all functional text, pricing details, UI components, and the terminal aesthetic. Gives it a raw, unpolished 'quant' edge.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[8vw] leading-[0.85] tracking-tighter uppercase font-black
hierarchy.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl leading-none tracking-tight uppercase font-black

layouts.hero: 100vh full-bleed, center-aligned kinetic typography overlaying a dark, abstract WebGL/3D scene or dark ambient product video.
layouts.manifesto: The 'Tetris' Grid Protocol. Asymmetrical, sticky scroll elements. Wide gaps (gap-12). Numbered chapters utilizing massive outline fonts (text-transparent webkit-text-stroke-1px white/20).
layouts.pricing: Dense bento-box style comparison. Use Aceternity 'Tracing Beam' effect for the Institutional tier card to make it glow.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-32 to py-48 for section transitions. Container padding px-6 md:px-12.

buttons.primary: Sharp edges (rounded-none), bg-white text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-zinc-200 transition-colors px-8 py-4
buttons.secondary: Sharp edges, border border-white/20 bg-transparent text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors px-8 py-4
buttons.danger: Sharp edges, bg-[#FF3333] text-white font-bold px-8 py-4 hover:bg-red-700 transition-colors

cards.default: Flat background (#111111), 1px subtle border (border-white/10), rounded-none, p-8 or p-12.

chat_widget.style: Floating bottom right. Glassmorphism panel. Monospace typography for chat messages, resembling a command-line interface but polished.

marquee.style: Slow editorial ribbon. font-mono text-sm tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-zinc-500 border-y border-white/10 py-4. Gaps of 4rem between items.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal. Wrap each line of text in an overflow-hidden span, and use framer-motion to translate-y from 100% to 0 with ease-[0.76, 0, 0.24, 1].
motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. All sections should have a subtle fade and translate-y on scroll using framer-motion 'whileInView'.
motion.microinteractions: Hover states on pricing cards lift slightly (-translate-y-2) and reveal a subtle red inner shadow or border glow.

images.description: Candlestick chart on dark screen. Use this as a texture/background for the strategy playground section.
Monitors displaying stock market charts in a dimly lit room. For multi-agent orchestrator chapter.
Close-up of server racks. Use for the 'offline licensing and non-bypassable risk gates' section to emphasize physical security.
Concentric rings of liquid paint. Use as a blurred background texture if 3D Canvas is too heavy.

media.image_treatment: All images should be clipped into strict rectangular or architectural frames (no rounded corners). Apply a grayscale filter with high contrast (grayscale contrast-125), and reveal full color on hover.

3d_libraries.strategy: Implement a subtle, slow-rotating point-cloud or wireframe sphere in the hero section background to represent 'quantitative data models'. Ensure lighting is stark (directional light to create harsh shadows).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against black backgrounds meets APCA standards. Use #F5F5F0 for primary text, never pure white (#FFFFFF) to reduce eye strain, except for buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, pricing toggles, copy buttons) MUST have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='buy-institutional-button').
accessibility.motion: Wrap heavy animations in a 'prefers-reduced-motion' media query check.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a landing page with an integrated e-commerce checkout flow (Home -> Checkout Redirect -> Confirmation Page). Manage these views using React Router or simple conditional rendering if it's a SPA.
Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/lenis (or lenis), @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, three, lucide-react, react-fast-marquee, sonner.
Setup Lenis smooth scrolling at the top level of the app.
Import Unbounded and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS.
Implement the Hero section with a massive kinetic typography component. Use Framer Motion to animate text line-by-line (e.g., 'SOVEREIGN.', 'QUANT.', 'OFFLINE.').
For the Manifesto section, use a CSS grid (Grid Mode A: Tetris Grid). Incorporate large numbers (1, 2, 3...) using webkit-text-stroke to achieve the 'numbered chapters' requirement.
For the Pricing section, implement three distinct tiers. The 'Institutional' card should be visually dominant.

Implement a realistic-looking checkout confirmation page layout where the generated HMAC offline licence key is displayed with a 'Copy to Clipboard' function. This page should look highly technical, like an offline terminal.
Build a floating AI concierge widget (Claude AI style) in the bottom right using a dark glassmorphism aesthetic.
Use JetBrains Mono (or any available monospace font) for all UI/data-heavy elements (like the license key, price figures, and code snippets).
Do NOT center-align paragraphs. Keep them left-aligned for a structural, Swiss grid aesthetic.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for any overlapping component like headers or dropdowns. Use the specified glassmorphism or solid dark background.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic outputs (AI slop). Make this UI look like a high-end luxury fashion brand mixed with a brutalist coding terminal.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as generic gradients. Use solid #050505 and #111111.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders, rather than soft shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Use sharp corners (rounded-none) to emphasize the 'brutalist/swiss' aesthetic, instead of standard pill-shaped buttons everywhere (unless specifically called out).
Never use placeholder URLs. Use the provided image URLs.
All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='checkout-button', data-testid='copy-licence-key-button').
Use 'sonner' for toasts (e.g., for the 'License key copied' notification).
general_ui_ux_guidelines: Content Strategy: The message is absolute privacy and extreme performance. Text should be concise and authoritative.
Interaction: Buttons should feel highly responsive. Use scale transforms (`active:scale-95`) to give tactile feedback.
Navigation: A strict, sticky top navigation bar with a glass effect. Links should have subtle underline animations on hover.
Data Display: Use monospace fonts and tabular-nums for all pricing, metrics, and license keys to ensure horizontal alignment.
